title: Letter Tile Possibilities
summary: Given n tiles with individual letters, calculate the total count of distinct non-empty sequences that can be formed using these letters.
statement: Given n tiles with individual letters, calculate the total count of distinct non-empty sequences that can be formed using these letters.
constraints: Tiles contain uppercase letters and length is at most seven.
Count distinct nonempty sequences of every possible length.
hints: Branch by the next letter value rather than by physical tile index to avoid duplicate sequences.
Track remaining frequency for each distinct letter.
For every positive count, count the new sequence, consume one tile, recurse, and restore it.
Each distinct sequence follows one unique path of letter choices, and all nonempty prefixes are counted.
editorial: Each distinct sequence follows one unique path of letter choices, and all nonempty prefixes are counted.

tests.explanation: The sole nonempty sequence is V.
